result.title: Declarative Explanations for Graph Neural Networks: A Demonstration
result.summary: Graph Neural Networks (GNNs) have proven effective for graph analytical tasks, yet their "black-box" nature complicates the understanding of their layer-wise behavior and hinders their application to large graphs. We demonstrate SliceGXQ, an end-to-end declarative and interactive system for querying and exploring layer-wise explanations for GNNs over large-scale graphs. In particular, SliceGXQ provides (1) an interactive graphical user interface for dataset, model, and explanation configuration; (2) a lightweight SPARQL-like parser that allows users to specify target nodes, layers, explanation modes, and constraints; and (3) an integrated execution and visualization workflow that invokes SliceGX as its underlying explanation engine. We demonstrate how users can diagnose a misclassified node, identify problematic layers and influential messages, and perform targeted model debugging, together with large-scale graph interpretation and fraud-detection analysis. Our demonstration video and source code are available at https://github.com/jinzhaoqet/SliceGXQ.

AI.brief_summary: 论文展示 SliceGXQ 系统：以类 SPARQL 的轻量查询语言指定目标节点、层、解释模式与约束，在交互式界面中查询并可视化大规模 GNN 的逐层解释，用于误分类诊断与模型调试。
AI.relevance_reason: 其「按层指定并查询解释」的声明式接口与影响力消息定位，可能为 LVR 中逐层状态贡献分配、证据筛选与中间层诊断工具提供类比线索，可供核查；但对象是图模型而非多模态推理，联系较远。
